mentions.name: Leafle
mentions.description: A chatbot that helps people choose library books. Users chat about things they've read, and it leverages the LLM's latent knowledge of books to suggest ones they might like. It can work on local libraries, and the author wired it up to a few thousand libraries around the world, with a coverage page showing the supported catalogs.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been playing around with exploiting LLMs having ‘read’ every book ever written to make a chatbot to help people choose library books. You talk to it a bit about things you’ve read, and it uses the llm’s latent knowledge of books to suggest ones you might like.
